context: A 420-line UserService bundles auth, persistence, email, and analytics, defended as 'everything in one place for the agent'. The criteria check whether the answer splits by responsibility on clean seams and pushes back on the misapplied rationale.

checklist.name: Recommends splitting by responsibility
checklist.description: Recommends splitting the class by responsibility and does NOT endorse keeping all four concerns in one file

checklist.name: Identifies independent seams
checklist.description: Identifies the seams (auth / persistence / email / analytics) as genuinely independent and isolatable

checklist.name: Ceiling and/or unrelated concerns
checklist.description: Cites the ~300-line ceiling AND/OR multiple-unrelated-concerns as the reason, not blind line count

checklist.name: Pushes back on keep-together rationale
checklist.description: Pushes back on the 'keep everything in one place for the agent' rationale as misapplied to a god object
